events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman and solo artist, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Mad for it? Liam Gallagher is 54 today. We're celebrating with a double dose of the man himself.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... living life in peace. John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' dropped 51 years ago today. Still sounds as powerful.

events.title: The original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago today, Apple unveiled the first iPod, changing how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered on this day in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Which Bond theme gets you feeling like 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary Beatles co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the life and music of the incomparable John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Revolution 9? Or just a classic? The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago today. What's your top track from the double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On the anniversary of his passing, we pay tribute to the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The show must go on. Today, we remember the incredible life and unparalleled talent of Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Norwegian Wood, anyone? The Beatles' groundbreaking 'Rubber Soul' album was released 61 years ago today. A true classic.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On the anniversary of his tragic passing, we remember the life and legacy of music icon John Lennon, who died on this day in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Give peace a chance. We remember the extraordinary John Lennon, who left us on this day, and whose music continues to inspire generations.
